steps.title: Halls of Honor trial 1: Rydda`Dar

requires.why: hohonora has flag_needed; zone flag 211 is set by povalor door when aerindar becomes 2 (povalor/player.lua) or potranquility door 23 alternate access
Trydan2Say only grants when the first character is not '1'

actions.detail: Say ready to Trydan Faye; he depops and A_Custodian_of_Marr spawns at his spot ('hail' and 'trials' are flavor only).
Engage the Custodian within 10 seconds or it depops; keep it between Y 1750 and 2300.
Rydda`Dar spawns where the Custodian died; kill it, keeping it between Y 1750 and 2300.
Every raid member hails the new Trydan Faye that spawns at -1725, 2040.

npcs.name: Rydda`Dar
npcs.notes: spawned at the Custodian's death spot

steps.credit: ClientCanFlag: hailing client whose current raid ID == recorded raid ID, else current group ID == recorded group ID, else the recorded solo client; recorded from Rydda`Dar's killer (raid ID if in raid, else group ID, else that client).
steps.message: An ethereal mist descends from the air and surrounds your very being. Your body begins to emanate with the power of Trydan Faye.
debug: Only the raid that killed the event's recorded mob is acknowledged: if your raid ID (or group ID if no raid) differs from the killer's at hail time, the flagger ignores your hail completely (no text).
Max 72 grants per run (flags < FLAG_LIMIT); the counter resets when someone says 'ready' to start a new run.
If you already have this bit you see 'You have already received credit for completing this trial.'
The flagger (# version) depops 10 minutes after spawning (depop timer 600000).
Custodian depops after 10 s unless engaged (depop timer paused only while in combat); Trydan then returns after ~1 s.
Rydda`Dar depops after 56 s out of combat (timer pauses while engaged); that is a failure: Trydan respawn timer set to 10 minutes.
Leash: Custodian or Rydda`Dar leaving Y 1750-2300 is moved home, hate wiped, and casts Balance of the Nameless.
RyddaDeathComplete returns before spawning #Trydan_Faye if the recorded killer is not a valid client.
steps.notes: On success the room trash is re-enabled with an 18 hour timer. No 'You have received a character flag!' line is printed for trial bits. The recorded raid/group/client IDs are never cleared in this encounter, so earlier winners stay eligible until zone shutdown.

steps.title: Halls of Honor trial 2: save the Villagers

requires.why: Rhaliq2Say only grants when the second character is not '1'

actions.detail: Say ready to Rhaliq Trell; he depops and A_Custodian_of_Marr spawns at his spot.
Engage within 10 seconds and kill it while X stays between 350 and 900.
Seven villagers and 12 attackers spawn; attackers run at the villagers after 4-26 s. Kill all 12.
Every raid member hails the new Rhaliq Trell at 456, 1374.

npcs.name: Granmuck_Reiga, Fligg_Starp, Trann_Berk, Shott_Tarbs, Ruark_Barr, Zullkata_Reeps, Maeryn_Malladry, Thullias_Rhidron, Herot_Terkins, Mirezvakla_Ry`Ten, Yarezka_Tri`Lok, Merken_Lysonn

steps.credit: ClientCanFlag: hailing client whose current raid ID == recorded raid ID, else current group ID == recorded group ID, else the recorded solo client; recorded from the Custodian's killer.
steps.message: An ethereal mist descends from the air and surrounds your very being. Your body begins to emanate with the power of Rhaliq Trell.
debug: Only the raid that killed the event's recorded mob is acknowledged: if your raid ID (or group ID if no raid) differs from the killer's at hail time, the flagger ignores your hail completely (no text).
Max 72 grants per run (flags < FLAG_LIMIT); the counter resets when someone says 'ready' to start a new run.
If you already have this bit you see 'You have already received credit for completing this trial.'
The flagger (# version) depops 10 minutes after spawning (depop timer 600000).

Each attacker has a 72 s depop timer that only pauses while it is engaged; if any attacker's timer runs out the trial fails (all attackers depop, Rhaliq respawns in 10 minutes). Pick up every attacker.
Raid credit is recorded from the Custodian's killer, not the last attacker's killer.
The Custodian's death only starts this trial if it dies at X >= 0.
The script has no fail check on villager deaths; only attacker timeouts fail it.
steps.notes: Success requires 12 attacker deaths (attackersKilled >= 12). Room trash re-enabled with an 18 hour timer on success.

steps.title: Halls of Honor trial 3: the Nomads (crazed Norrathians)

requires.why: Alekson2Say only grants when the third character is not '1'

actions.detail: Say ready to Alekson Garn; he depops and A_Custodian_of_Marr spawns at his spot.
Engage within 10 seconds and kill it while X stays between -2800 and -2200.
Three groups of trash (6, 5, 5) spawn; clearing each group spawns its boss: Advocent_Joran, Halgoz_Rellinic, Freegan_Haun.
Kill all three bosses.
Every raid member hails the new Alekson Garn at -2330, -1724.

steps.credit: ClientCanFlag: hailing client whose current raid ID == recorded raid ID, else current group ID == recorded group ID, else the recorded solo client; recorded from the Custodian's killer.
steps.message: An ethereal mist descends from the air and surrounds your very being. Your body begins to emanate with the power of Alekson Garn.
debug: Only the raid that killed the event's recorded mob is acknowledged: if your raid ID (or group ID if no raid) differs from the killer's at hail time, the flagger ignores your hail completely (no text).
Max 72 grants per run (flags < FLAG_LIMIT); the counter resets when someone says 'ready' to start a new run.
If you already have this bit you see 'You have already received credit for completing this trial.'
The flagger (# version) depops 10 minutes after spawning (depop timer 600000).

Every trash mob and boss has a 50 s depop timer that only pauses while engaged; any expiry fails the trial with the zone emote 'A woman screams in anguish as she's forcibly taken away by a band of crazed norrathians.'
Raid credit is recorded from the Custodian's killer.
The Custodian's death only starts this trial if it dies at Y <= 0.
On success #Alekson_Garn says 'Congratulations my friends. You've passed the trial I laid before you.'
steps.notes: #popflags calls this the 'Nomad trial'. Alekson respawns 10 minutes after a failure. The first-room trash spawns at the Custodian's death spot.

steps.title: Unlock memories: Mithaniel cipher half

actions.detail: Sit, then ask the Seer to unlock memories.

steps.credit: the speaking player only
steps.message: An Image of Mithaniel flashes before you, 'You have finally earned a place of Honor.  Wear this Cipher with pride.' / You have received a character flag!
debug: You must be sitting when you say it; standing gets 'You will never be able to focus unless you are relaxed.  Please, sit down for a moment and allow me to [unlock your memories].'
The text must contain both 'unlock' and 'memories' (two separate findi checks).
With no cl_* flag at all you get 'You manage to recover some images from your childhood, but no recent events spark a memory.'
The cl_* flag is deleted only on success; on the locked path it stays and you can retry later.
Locked text (trials incomplete): 'An Image of Mithaniel flashes before you, 'You have yet to earn a place of Honor.  When you have, we will speak again.''
steps.notes: The Seer does not check for an existing cipher; it just sets mmarr 1.

Kill Evynd; #Askr_the_Lost appears.
Each player says transport to be moved to the next Torden level.
Kill Emmerik; ##Askr_the_Lost appears.
Say 'what storm' to spawn A_Chaotic_Vortex.

Kill Agnarr; Karana spawns at -477, -1758.

steps.credit: n/a (access step)
steps.message: No flag message.
debug: Clicking door 51 without access: 1st 'Magical energies shoot through your body.', 2nd 'You hear the cracking of stones around you.', 3rd wakes the storm watchers (counter is zone-wide).
Raid/group authorization from a Symbol click lasts 300 s and is matched by raid ID (or group ID if not raided).
##Askr's hail text shows [Storm] but the script only matches 'what storm'.
'transport' is per player: everyone must say it themselves.
steps.notes: How to assemble the Symbol of Torden is outside this part (Eindride Icestorm drops the Unadorned Symbol of Torden, item 17169, via ProgressionLoot).

Entries are processed in order cl_behemoth, cl_vallon, cl_tallon with updated values, so one unlock can chain zeks 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 5 if you hold all three checklist flags.
